contributions.statement: Block merges between internal Java repos on a static API-diff check, since syntactic breaking-change detection is mature in statically typed ecosystems, and add consumer behavioral/contract tests for the breaks such tools miss.
contributions.evidence: §5.4 Tables 10-13 and §7.2.2: synthesized detection results (e.g. ROSEAU F1=0.99) from primary studies, numbers not normalized; single-screener LLM-assisted selection.
relative_to: API/binary compatibility checkers in CI (japicmp, revapi)

contributions.statement: Do not trust semantic-version bumps between internal repos as a compatibility signal.
contributions.evidence: §4.2.2, §7.1.2: a handful of Maven/npm studies of SemVer violations.
relative_to: SemVer violations in Maven (Raemaekers et al., pre-2026)

reason: A reasonable synthesis of breaking-change literature, but every actionable item is established pre-2026 practice and nothing is agent-specific. It adds volume, not evidence.
